caption: The Responses tab of the test project in the UserHelp.co app on the free plan: the sidebar with Create new project, the project list, Contact us, Read docs, Upgrade and Profile, the tabs Content, Setup, Responses and Settings, an orange bar with the text Only the 5 oldest responses are shown. Upgrade with a one-time payment to view all of them. and the button Upgrade to view all, and an empty table with the columns Timestamp, Contact info, Description, Screenshot and Actions. The project ID line is covered.

The Content tab with the widget preview open on the right: the form fields Name, Email and Description (required), the buttons Capture screenshot and Submit, the checkbox Include my browser details and the line Powered by UserHelp.co. The Content tab has the Design box (Button text Report a problem, colors, Dark mode, Pick a language) and the Data collection box with Categories and an Add category button. The preview says that submitting and capturing a screenshot are disabled, so no report was sent. The project ID line is covered.

The Upgrade page: the box Upgrade your account with Unlimited projects (Free accounts are limited to one project), Every response (all of your responses, not just the first 5), Session replay, Technical details, Categories, Team workflow, Public discussions, Integrations (Zapier or a webhook) and No watermark, and the blue button for paying $59 one-time (partly below the visible part, not clicked). On the right are the Email add-on box (Email support inbox, Reply notifications, Branded emails, with the line that you must upgrade your account first and no price) and the Lifetime deal box with an empty LTD code field. No account detail is on this screen.
